messages.content: What type of personality am I?

function.name: calculate_big_five_traits
function.description: Calculate the big five personality traits based on a set of questions answered by the user. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

answers.description: Answers to a set of questions rated on a scale from 1 to 5.

calculate_percentile.description: If true, the percentile rank for each trait will also be calculated.

average_answers.description: If true, answers will be averaged across each trait's questions.

message.content:
I’d love to help you get a clearer picture of your personality!  
One common way people explore this is through the **Big Five Personality Traits** (also called OCEAN):

| Trait | What It Measures |
|-------|------------------|
| Openness | Curiosity & imagination |
| Conscientiousness | Organization & self‑discipline |
| Extraversion | Energy & sociability |
| Agreeableness | Compassion & cooperation |
| Neuroticism | Emotional stability |

If you’re interested, I can give you a brief quiz with a few statements. You’ll rate each one on a scale from **1 (Strongly Disagree)** to **5 (Strongly Agree)**. Once you’ve filled it out, I’ll run the numbers—optionally giving you percentiles compared to typical ranges—and tell you where you fall on each dimension.

Would you like me to send over the questions now?
